processing_tool.name: Pillow
processing_tool.alpha_resampling: convert RGBA to premultiplied RGBa, resize with Image.Resampling.LANCZOS, convert back to RGBA
processing_tool.crop_rule: find source subject bbox at alpha > 8, pad all sides by 4% of its long edge, preserve all alpha values inside that crop

dds_conversion.backend: converter FFmpeg BGRA fallback; texconv was not selected
dds_conversion.output_format: legacy uncompressed BGRA DDS, one level, no mipmaps
dds_conversion.strict_validation: 128-byte legacy header, BGRA masks, DDSCAPS_TEXTURE, 18x18 RGBA decode, alpha 0-255, 1424 bytes total, decoded pixels equal processed PNG exactly

source.exact_submitted_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original Hearts of Iron IV inline resource texticon for a decision cost row, processed to a transparent 18x18 RGBA runtime canvas
Primary request: Create one original compact symbol for Medical Reserve, the stored stock of medicines and field medical supplies maintained for plague response. It must read as an inventory resource, distinct from the existing decision action icon.
Input images: Image 1 is the installed vanilla HOI4 fuel texticon, used only to guide the tiny resource-icon footprint, value contrast, muted painterly treatment, and clean silhouette; do not repeat its subject. Image 2 is the current Event 020 Medical Reserve decision icon, used only to understand the event’s medical-supply subject; do not trace, copy, or repeat its crate composition.
Scene/backdrop: No scene. Genuine transparent background.
Subject: A compact olive-drab field medical satchel with a clear ivory medical cross on the front, a visible rolled bandage and one small medicine vial peeking from the open top. It should feel like a reserve of supplies ready for deployment.
Style/medium: Small period-grounded Hearts of Iron IV resource icon, painterly hand-rendered object with restrained shading, worn canvas/leather, subtle dark edge definition, warm olive and brown tones, ivory cross. Strong readable silhouette and contrast when reduced to 18x18.
Composition/framing: Single centered object on a square canvas, filling roughly 80 percent while retaining transparent margin; keep all edges intact. Simplify internal detail so the satchel and medical cross remain legible at native texticon size.
Lighting/mood: Soft directional highlight, understated and practical.
Color palette: Muted olive drab, dark brown, warm ivory, a restrained muted glass green.
Materials/textures: Worn canvas satchel, compact rolled gauze, one glass vial; painted texture only where it survives downsampling.
Constraints: Ask for real alpha transparency in the initial image. No opaque or painted background, no tile, no border or frame, no text, letters, numbers, watermark, fake checkerboard, white sticker outline, glow, or extra props. No people, blood, gore, modern objects, or copied reference artwork.
